notes.text: Alexandra (Alix) Yates, Conference Director at IQPC (London), is organizing a conference at which the owner, listed as Vince Kaminski, Managing Director, Enron Corp, presents on real options.

The owner's IQPC session is titled "Understanding Real Options and Their Role Within Decision Making", covering real options for investment optimisation, uncertainty as strategy, and integrating real options into decision making.
Alix Yates asked the owner to approve the brochure bullet points for his IQPC talk; she was going to print that afternoon and would assume they were okay unless he replied with changes.
